title: Grandia
overview:
Only the soul of a pure adventurer can open the door to an unknown world

In a quiet port town, young Justin dreams of following in the footsteps of his late father, an adventurer. Rumors of a newly discovered continent are spreading, while the Garlyle Forces search ancient ruins for a power sealed away by a lost civilization. When Justin and his friend Sue explore the ruins near home and a spirit stone opens a hidden door, the legends begin to look real, and a grand journey begins.

Enemies are visible as you explore, so you can sneak up for a first strike or get caught from behind. In battle, an action gauge sets the order of attacks for friend and foe alike, and characters move around the field to reach enemies or dodge them. Weapon skills and magic grow stronger the more you use them, and new magic is gained from mana eggs.

- Two-disc adventure
- Interact with objects in the field to open doors, lower bridges and more

汚れなき冒険者の魂だけが、未知なる世界への扉を開く
